ordinary_player_economic_loop.status: proposed acceptance scenario; not implemented or executed; blocked at economic receipt gaps
ordinary_player_economic_loop.ordinary_player: Existing ordinary owned character; no GM creation, SQL seed, admin commands or assumption of Merchant skills.
ordinary_player_economic_loop.budget: Require observed initial zeny Z0, explicit operator spend cap B, retained reserve R, quotes, fees and received capacity. Commit only while pending+new spend <= B and actual balance-new cost >= R; all variables unknown until observed. No numeric market prices or expected profit invented.

steps.action: Observe healthy current-epoch complete inventory, life/position, zeny and weight/capacity; obtain explicit spend/reserve/discard policy.
steps.completion: Exact received initial ledger or STOP_BLOCKED; the archived fixtures start empty, not stocked.

steps.action: Earn at most five actual accessible loot pickups via legal combat/navigation covered by combat-progression report, or use already owned expendable stock; never grant stock.
steps.completion: Actual current stock acquired; no loot before deadline => STOP_NO_STOCK, not success.

steps.action: Visit observed valid ordinary NPC shop; sell one approved expendable batch, preserving gear/ammo/material reserve.
steps.completion: Sale result, stock loss and zeny credit reconcile; unknown quote/action support => STOP_BLOCKED.

steps.action: Buy one offered usable healing item within actual funds, reserve and capacity; use once only when legitimate effect needed.
steps.completion: Purchase ACK+actual debit/addition, then use ACK+consumption/effect; no injured/eligible state => record conditional use not exercised.

steps.action: If legally owned suitable equipment exists, request at most one equip after full class/sex/level/map/slot validation. Do not buy hypothetical equipment or autoequip from allowedLocation.
steps.completion: Fresh own-epoch/index equip ACK AND worn-state receipt; absent equipment/legality observer => NOT_EXERCISED or STOP_BLOCKED.

steps.action: If an actual authorized storage service is available, deposit then withdraw one expendable legal item, each once.
steps.completion: Both-container inverse deltas and fees reconcile; unavailable service => NOT_EXERCISED.

steps.action: Optional authorized ordinary partner trade: inspect final offer, both lock, commit once each; no partner => skip without waiting indefinitely.
steps.completion: Both completion results and actual conserved inventory/zeny changes; unconfirmed commit => STOP_UNCERTAIN.

steps.action: Optional one actually legal recipe/service attempt only if existing class/skill and observed materials permit it; otherwise skip.
steps.completion: Craft result plus materials/currency/output deltas; consumed failure is recorded failure, never fictional production or retry.

steps.action: Close sessions; observe final same-epoch exact stock/wear/zeny/capacity and reconcile each completed receipt. End, do not start another cycle.
steps.completion: COMPLETE_CORE only for received sale+purchase and required usage effects; optional storage/trade/equip/craft get independent exercised/pass/fail/not_exercised verdicts.

stop_conditions: Negative ACK or changed quote: record failure and terminate that action.
Unknown outcome after request: stop uncertain, resnapshot with explicit authorization, never resend economic mutation blindly.
cross_refs: combat-progression: lawful earning/navigation and ammo-use details
npc-world-quests: actual service discovery and dialogue
class-specials-rulesets: recipe/class skill acquisition and exceptions
social-guild-woe: partner authorization and guild-storage access
ordinary_player_economic_loop.not_claimed: No executed loop, profitability, sustained population, merchant shop activity, class completion or native equipment acceptance.

top_five_gaps: P0: Current owned item instances and all mutation deltas are not exposed coherently; counts/standalone metadata cannot authorize transactions.
P0: Received zeny, weight/slots, quotes and reserve accounting are missing from the audited economic decision surface.
P0: NPC shop buy/sell and use-item actions lack correlated positive ACK + actual stock/zeny/effect acceptance.
P0: Equip codec approval is representational only; complete legality, framing/intent correlation and actual worn state remain unaccepted.
P1: Storage/trade/cart/market/crafting lack multi-container or two-party reconciled transaction receipts; concrete service/recipe applicability remains partly unknown.
